metadata.title: OEM-Specific UDS Data Identifier (DID) Diagnostic Knowledge Base
sources: ISO 14229:2006 Annex F (via python-udsoncan DataIdentifier, MIT)

0x1153.name: DPF Soot Mass Measured
0x1153.description: Exhaust differential pressure derived soot accumulation in particulate filter.

0x1154.name: DPF Soot Mass Calculated
0x1154.description: ECU volumetric combustion model estimated soot load (>24g triggers active regen, >40g service regen).

0x115E.name: DPF Oil Ash Mass
0x115E.description: Unburnable metallic engine oil additive ash residue (>80g requires DPF replacement or cleaning).

0x1160.name: Distance Since Last Regeneration
0x1160.name_tr: Son Rejenerasyondan Bu Yana Kat Edilen Yol
0x1160.description: Vehicle odometer distance driven since last completed thermal DPF burn cycle.

0x0501.name: Boost Pressure Specified
0x0501.description: Engine map target charge pressure requested by Bosch/Siemens ECU.

0x0502.name: Boost Pressure Actual
0x0502.description: Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) sensor actual measured charge air pressure.

0x2035.name: DSG Clutch 1 Actual Hydraulic Pressure
0x2035.description: Mechatronic main pressure delivered to odd-gear clutch pack (Nominal 2.5 - 18.0 bar).

0x2036.name: DSG Clutch 2 Actual Hydraulic Pressure
0x2036.description: Mechatronic main pressure delivered to even-gear clutch pack.

0x2037.name: DSG Transmission Fluid Temperature
0x2037.description: Transmission fluid sump temperature measured by mechatronics G510 sensor.

0x2A10.name: Steering Angle Sensor Actual Angle
0x2A10.description: Steering wheel optical/magnetic rotation angle (Nominal straight: 0.0° ±1.5°).

0xD001.name: VANOS Intake Camshaft Position Actual
0xD001.name_tr: VANOS Emiş Kam Mili Gerçek Konumu
0xD001.description: Intake camshaft angular deviation relative to crankshaft in degrees.

0xD002.name: VANOS Exhaust Camshaft Position Actual
0xD002.name_tr: VANOS Egzoz Kam Mili Gerçek Konumu
0xD002.description: Exhaust camshaft phase angle controlled by proportional hydraulic solenoid.

0xD010.name: Valvetronic Eccentric Shaft Angle
0xD010.description: Position of eccentric shaft driven by brushless servomotor controlling intake valve lift.

0xD105.name: Common Rail Pressure Actual
0xD105.description: Piezoelectric rail pressure sensor real-time physical measurement (Rölanti ~300 bar, Tam Yük >1800 bar).

0xD210.name: HV Battery Pack State of Charge (SOC)
0xD210.description: Usable battery pack state of charge displayed to high-voltage energy manager.

0xD215.name: HV Insulation Resistance
0xD215.description: BMS continuous isolation resistance between HV DC bus and 12V chassis ground (Warning <500 kΩ).

0x1E01.name: Cylinder Head Temperature (CHT)
0x1E01.description: Solid-state cylinder head metal temperature sensor preventing boilover and thermal cracking.

0x1E1C.name: Transmission Fluid Temperature (TFT)
0x1E1C.description: Torque converter and transmission case fluid temperature (Nominal 85°C - 100°C).

0x0200.name: Engine Oil Life Remaining
0x0200.description: Intelligent Oil Life Monitor (IOLM) calculated oil degradation percentage.

0x0118.name: HV Battery Pack Terminal Voltage
0x0118.name_tr: Yüksek Voltaj Batarya Paketi Terminal Voltajı
0x0118.description: Total battery pack terminal DC voltage measured across primary pyro disconnect.

0x0119.name: HV Battery Pack Current
0x0119.description: Total instantaneous pack DC current (Positive = Discharge/Drive, Negative = Regen/Charge).

0x0120.name: Maximum Cell Temperature
0x0120.description: Maximum individual battery module cell temperature reported by CSC monitoring boards.

0x0121.name: Minimum Cell Temperature
0x0121.description: Minimum individual battery cell temperature used for preconditioning target calculation.

0x0130.name: High Voltage Isolation Resistance
0x0130.description: Continuously monitored isolation resistance between HV battery pack and chassis ground.

0x0140.name: Pyrotechnic Battery Fuse Status
0x0140.description: Status of pyro-fuse circuit (0 = Armed/Intact, 1 = Blown/Disconnected).

0x011A.name: Rail Pressure Actual Value
0x011A.description: High pressure common rail fuel delivery measured pressure on OM642/OM651 engines.

0x0256.name: Transmission Fluid Temperature
0x0256.description: Transmission electrohydraulic control unit embedded oil sump temperature sensor.

0x0342.name: AdBlue / DEF Concentration Quality
0x0342.description: Ultrasonic concentration measurement of aqueous urea solution (Target: 32.5% ISO 22241).

0x0504.name: 48V EQ Boost Battery State of Charge
0x0504.name_tr: 48V EQ Boost Hafif Hibrit Şarj Durumu
0x0504.description: State of charge of the 48-volt auxiliary lithium-ion energy storage module.

0x2101.name: Motor Generator 2 (MG2) Stator Temperature
0x2101.description: Traction motor generator stator winding thermal sensor for inverter protection.

0x2103.name: HV Traction Battery State of Health
0x2103.name_tr: Yüksek Voltaj Hibrit Batarya Sağlık Durumu (SOH)
0x2103.description: Remaining battery capacity relative to original factory nominal capacity.

0x2120.name: HV Battery Block Internal Resistance
0x2120.description: Internal resistance of NiMH/Li-Ion battery blocks indicating degradation.

0x2168.name: D-4S Port vs Direct Fuel Injection Ratio
0x2168.name_tr: D-4S Emme Manifoldu / Direkt Enjeksiyon Oranı
0x2168.description: Ratio of direct in-cylinder injection versus port fuel injection under current load.

0x1015.name: GDI High Pressure Fuel Rail Sensor
0x1015.name_tr: GDI Direkt Enjeksiyon Yakıt Ray Basıncı
0x1015.description: High pressure fuel rail sensor pressure on Theta / Smartstream engines.

0x1028.name: DCT Clutch 1 & 2 Wear Clearance
0x1028.description: Actuator stroke travel clearance measuring dry/wet dual clutch lining thickness.

0x1070.name: E-GMP 800V EV Battery Pack Voltage
0x1070.name_tr: E-GMP 800V EV Batarya Paketi Toplam Voltajı
0x1070.description: Total high voltage DC bus pack voltage measured by Battery Management System.
